items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: And later, I really got to meet him and know him and become friends with him.

ctx.x: But in the meantime, in listening to the local pianists around, and by this time I'm beginning to move around and sneak into the club every now and then, hearing different people and hearing people talk about other musicians. I think I must have come in contact with what people call this word "genius." I never realized what that word really meant. And as a matter of fact, I didn't realize that that's what Art Tatum was. I think they were geniuses. That's a relative term. I guess it's up to the way you see the…

Anyway, there was a local fellow in Washington here, he was a young man -- I guess he must have been around 18 or 19. His name was Toby Walker. He was a hunchback, and he'd kind of sit sideways at the piano. He just fantastic things on the piano, beyond... I thought this fellow James Morgan that I mentioned before was great, which he really was. But this guy Toby Walker was just beyond anything I had heard in person. Unfortunately, he died when he was 25 years old. And later, I really got to meet him and know him…
